entries.ed34e67c77958afd: Under its basic philosophy, the company's policy centers on supporting the sustainable development of water and sewerage infrastructure through safe, secure and stable water supply, improvement of water quality in public water bodies, formation of resource and energy circulation, and maintenance information services utilizing DX. As issues to be addressed, the company cites securing orders through sales activities in line with government budget policies and local government fiscal policies, reducing total costs, developing and proposing advanced services that meet market needs, efforts toward regional consolidation and joint initiatives and public-private partnership projects, promoting DX-related businesses by leveraging the development capabilities of the Kurakkusu System, and promoting well-being management offering diverse work styles.
